result.title: FETALFusion: Resolution-Aware State-Space Modeling for Multi-Domain Fetal Head Segmentation
result.comment: Accepted at the 15th International Conference on Image Processing Theory, Tools and Applications, 2026
result.summary: Head circumference (HC) measured from 2D ultrasound is a routine marker of fetal growth, and automating it needs segmentations whose boundaries hold up on individual scans, not only on average. We present FETALFusion, a dual-path CNN-Mamba encoder-decoder for fetal head segmentation across acquisition types. It applies four-directional state-space scans only at the two highest-resolution stages, routes bottleneck features through domain-specific channel gates that are averaged at test time, and adds a weak landmark shape prior. We train jointly on transabdominal (HC-18) and transperineal (PSFHS) images and compare ten methods on a held-out test set of 471 images, each trained under one schedule and scored by surface distances at native resolution. FETALFusion reaches a Dice score of 0.963 and an HD95 of 2.10 mm without test-time augmentation or a domain label. It improves on U-Mamba on all five reported metrics (HD95 reduced by 0.31 mm; Holm-corrected ($p < 10^{-4}$), a lead that holds under test-time augmentation and across two independent training runs, and in the mean on U-Net, Attention U-Net and TransUNet. Residual encoders close the gap: a ResNet-34 UNet++ exceeds FETALFusion, and an ImageNet initialised ResNet-34 U-Net is best overall (HD95 1.75 mm). The ablation agrees. Calibrated against run-to-run variation, it attributes FETALFusion's measurable gains to the landmark shape prior and, on transperineal images, to the domain gates, while removing the state-space branch does not measurably change accuracy. HC from the predicted masks agrees with the clinical reference at an intraclass correlation of 0.9986.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FETALFusion，一种双路径 CNN-Mamba 编码解码器，用于跨采集体位（经腹与经会阴）的胎儿头部超声分割，并加入域特定通道门与弱地标形状先验。
AI.relevance_reason: 属医学图像分割的应用与刷分工作，其中的「state-space」只是 Mamba 序列建模算子、并非推理期 latent 状态，也未涉及证据获取、停止决策或监督分配，与 LVR 主线无实质联系。
